title: SDDM stuck on boot loop?
body: hello everyone! yesterday I updated arch as normally, and today when trying to open my PC, SDDM has been stuck in a weird restart loop, in which the login screen flickers for a second, then goes back to the arch boot screen and starts up a new session. I tried switching to another TTY but it doesn't work. how should I proceed in this situation?
